evidence.quote:
every one else conspired towards an education which he hated. From
cradle to grave this problem
Yet Quincy was not a bed of thornless roses. From cradle to grave this problem of running order through chaos

adjudications.reason: In the source, 'this problem' points back to the sentence about brothers, sisters and everyone else conspiring towards an education he hated. The revision cut that sentence. 'This problem of running order through chaos' now follows the thornless-roses line directly and has no stated antecedent. That weakens the planned task-of-education dependency and the boy's war with his tamers, which frames the school walk.

evidence.quote: be then staying there, on his way to Washington, had fallen and hurt
who happened to be then staying there, had fallen and hurt himself
If the scene on the floor of the House, when the old President fell

adjudications.reason: The continuity check requires both the Mount Vernon Street collapse and the fall 'on the floor of the House' to stand without contradiction. The source bridges them with 'on his way to Washington,' and the revision removed that phrase. Without it, a man paralysed in Boston next falls in Congress with no hint of how he got there. Restoring the four source words repairs the link.

remaining_concerns: These repairs add about 31 words above the 3700-word target. As this pass instructs, no offsetting cuts were made.
